title: Olivia Kaitlyn Roberts
text:
View CV
Welcome to my website! I am an epidemiology research assistant at the University of Michigan School of Public Health. My current area of research focuses on tobacco control, where I analyze trends in tobacco use using multistate transition modeling as part of the data analysis and modeling team for the Center for the Assessment of Tobacco Regulations (CAsToR). I am a recent graduate of the Computational Epidemiology and Systems Modeling master’s program at the University of Michigan, where I also completed a graduate certificate in Complex Systems.
I earned my undergraduate degree in Mathematics, with minors in Music and Interdisciplinary Sciences, from the University of South Dakota in 2024. During my time there, I did research on the intersection of mathematical group theory and music theory. I am passionate about teaching mathematics and have experience working as a math tutor, a course assistant for a high school summer math camp, and an instructor assistant for a nursing statistics course.
Outside of academia, I am also a dedicated yoga practitioner and teacher; I have been teaching yoga since 2021 and have organized yoga festivals and workshops. I hold two 200-hour yoga teaching certifications and have experience teaching vinyasa, sculpt, and ashtanga yoga. My teaching schedule at University of Michigan Recreation can be found here.
